summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories filed a Form 6-K with an exhibit dated August 14, 2026, disclosing that the USFDA completed a GMP inspection at its FTO-3 formulations facility in Bachupally, Hyderabad, from August 6-14, 2026. The company received a Form 483 with four observations, which it will address within the stipulated timeline. This is a routine regulatory disclosure regarding an inspection outcome, not a special-situation corporate event. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or capital markets activity is involved. The filing merely informs exchanges and shareholders of the inspection result.
